reliable: Map gate criteria to bound artifacts and select one usable restricted representation with an exact interface.
exploratory: Challenge oracle/cost assumptions, compare alternatives and distinguish genuine readiness blockers from the next task obligations.
first_informative_check: Can the proposed representation be instantiated using existing declared finite inputs and proofs without assuming all mathematical models or a free consistency oracle?
likely_failure: Mistaking P3-02 exact finite expected-loss information for a ready logical-uncertainty learner, or treating contribution support as a prerequisite for this technical gate.
stop_rule: Complete the gate when its evidence is assessed and records are synchronized; no padding or automatic P3-03 work.
